gao-gaoreports-gao-06-729g:
Standards for government auditors are set out in GAO-06-729G, an exposure draft GAO released on June 1, 2006. The draft revises the Government Auditing Standards, known as the Yellow Book. Those standards govern audits of public funds across federal, state, and local bodies. The revision supersedes the 2003 version. As an exposure draft, it was put out for comment before taking final form.

The draft lays out rules for auditor independence, training, and quality control. It also contains requirements for reporting on internal control in financial audits. Other chapters cover performance audits, from planning to evidence and reporting. Readers can see the full text of the proposed rules, with the reasoning that links them. The document is a reference for anyone who audits public money.
gao-gaoreports-gao-08-1029g:
Federal audit guidance for computer systems is set out in GAO manual GAO-08-1029G, released July 31, 2008. The document is the exposure draft of the Federal Information System Controls Audit Manual. It lays out a method for auditing the controls of information systems. Its users audit federal and other government bodies under professional standards.

GAO first issued the manual in January 1999. This draft updates it for major changes that affect such audits. A short letter transmits the draft and invites review and comment. The manual helps auditors judge whether systems guard data, process it correctly, and stay available for the work agencies depend on.
podcast-joerogan-fOTMWZNYg9g:
Singer and songwriter Skylar Grey joins Joe Rogan for episode 2504. Grey wrote huge hooks for other stars before stepping forward herself. Her voice carries a sad, clear tone fans know at once.

Rogan asks about the music trade and the cost of fame. Grey tells how big songs get built and sold. She shares the strain of writing pain for a living. The episode gives music lovers a rare long talk with a writer who shaped hits from behind the scenes, in her own words. Her craft earns respect in every answer she gives.
